topics.title: Advanced Logical Connectors & Discourse Markers (Connecteurs Logiques et Marqueurs du Discours)
topics.objective: Master and correctly deploy advanced discourse connectors and logical markers expressing Concession, Opposition, Consequence, and Addition in formal written and spoken French.

topics.title: Compound Relative Pronouns (Lequel / Laquelle / Lesquels / Lesquelles & Contracted Forms)
topics.objective: Form and correctly position compound relative pronouns (*lequel, laquelle, lesquels, lesquelles*) and their contractions (*auquel, auxquels, auquel, auxquelles, duquel, desquels, duquel, desquelles*) after prepositions to introduce non-human or precise antecedent relative clauses.

topics.title: Conditional Perfect / Past Conditional (Conditionnel Passé)
topics.objective: Construct and deploy the past conditional to express past hypotheticals, regret, reproach, and unconfirmed past news or statements.

topics.title: Nominalisation of Verbal Actions & Adjectives (La Nominalisation)
topics.objective: Convert active verbal clauses and adjectival predicates into formal, compact noun phrases using derivational suffixation (-tion, -ment, -age, -ure, -ité, -ence/ance) and genitive *de* complements in journalistic and formal registers.

topics.title: Emphatic Cleft Constructions (Phrases Clivées : c'est... qui / que, ce qui... c'est, ce que... c'est)
topics.objective: Form, analyze, and apply emphatic cleft sentences (*c'est... qui*, *c'est... que*, *ce qui... c'est*, *ce que... c'est*, *ce dont... c'est*) to highlight sentence elements (subject, direct object, prepositional/adverbial complement) and establish contrastive focus in written and spoken discourse.
topics.spacy_pattern:
# Pattern 1: Standard Cleft (c'est / ce sont + [Focus Element] + qui / que / qu')
pattern_cleft_standard = [
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["c'", "ce"]}},
    {"LEMMA": "être", "POS": {"IN": ["AUX", "VERB"]}},
    {"OP": "+"},  # Intermediate focused element (noun phrase, pronoun, prepositional phrase, adverb)
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["qui", "que", "qu'"]}, "POS": {"IN": ["PRON", "SCONJ"]}}
]

# Pattern 2: Pseudo-cleft / Reversed Cleft (ce qui / ce que / ce dont ... c'est / ce sont)
pattern_pseudo_cleft = [
    {"LOWER": "ce"},
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["qui", "que", "qu'", "dont"]}},
    {"OP": "+"},
    {"LOWER": {"IN": ["c'", "ce"]}},
    {"LEMMA": "être", "POS": {"IN": ["AUX", "VERB"]}}
]
